text: 10 OVERDOSAGE With IV administration, an overdose of GAMMAGARD LIQUID ERC may lead to fluid overload and hyperviscosity. Patients at risk of complications of fluid overload and hyperviscosity include elderly patients and those with cardiac or renal impairment.
